name: Beverly Center
summary: High-end shopping mall offers luxury designer shops, well-known department stores & restaurants.
description: Beverly Center is an iconic eight-story shopping destination in the heart of Los Angeles, featuring premier fashion retailers, upscale dining, and entertainment options. Located at the crossroads of Beverly Hills and West Hollywood, this modernized center offers a sophisticated shopping experience with contemporary architecture and luxury amenities.
demographics: Beverly Center attracts an affluent, fashion-forward demographic with household incomes predominantly above $100,000, drawing heavily from the surrounding Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, and Mid-Wilshire neighborhoods. The primary visitor base consists of professionals aged 25-54, along with international tourists and entertainment industry professionals seeking premium brands and designer fashion. Shoppers typically exhibit strong purchasing power with preferences for contemporary fashion, luxury goods, and experiential dining, making multiple visits per month for both destination shopping and social experiences.
